problem: Eviction changed from q[0] <= cutoff to q[0] < cutoff, so an entry still counts at now == t + window and allow()/remaining() over-block by one boundary tick versus the documented (now - window, now] window.
With the new boundary, retry_after returns 0.0 at now == q[0] + window while allow() denies and remaining() is 0, so clients told to retry immediately are denied again and can spin.
Inline __import__("collections").deque() duplicates the existing deque import and setdefault allocates a new deque on every call, including when the key exists.
The comment documenting the (now - window, now] window semantics was removed, leaving the boundary rule undocumented.
